title: One Bank Event, One Relief: FlexLine Replacement Relief and Personal Loans
content:
**Ruling — FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit.** The relief basis follows the borrower's Larkspur Personal Loans on the return date, so that one bank event earns relief once: when a personal-loan returned-payment fee booked on the line's return date (the one recorded first when there are two) already carries a personal-loan fee waiver, the basis is the line's fee less the amount waived on that loan fee, never below 0.00; when such a loan fee was booked and carries no waiver, the basis is the line's fee but no more than the tier's flat returned-payment fee; with no personal-loan returned-payment fee booked on that date, the basis is the line's fee.

The relief basis is the amount the replacement relief is figured from. *The line's fee* is the returned-payment fee booked against the line's return; *the return date* is the date of that return.

**Records read.** The borrower's Personal Loans entries: returned-payment fee entries on any of the borrower's personal loans dated on the line's return date, and the fee-waiver entries booked against that loan fee, their amounts added up. A loan fee carries a waiver when at least one fee-waiver entry is booked against it, whatever the amount of that entry; an entry of 0.00 still counts as a waiver and takes nothing off the line's fee.

| Personal-loan returned-payment fee on the line's return date | Waiver against it | Relief basis |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | the line's fee less the amount waived, never below 0.00 |
| yes | no | the smaller of the line's fee and the tier's flat returned-payment fee |
| no | — | the line's fee |

*Hypothetical cases (tier flat fee 15.00 USD):* line fee 15.00 with a 10.00 waiver on the loan fee — basis 5.00; line fee 27.50 with no waiver on the loan fee — basis 15.00; line fee 27.50 with a 0.00 waiver entry on the loan fee — basis 27.50; line fee 27.50 with no loan fee that date — basis 27.50.
